summary: Replaced the missing Supabase CLI fallback with a shared build-time Management API reader. It obtains operator auth at the query point, sends one fixed SELECT with read_only=true, accepts only HTTP 201 with a top-level row array, validates every row, and reports sanitized failures. All three catalog/ledger callers now await that reader.

verification.check: source inspection of shared helper and all callers
verification.result: No CLI invocation remains; fixed SELECT queries flow through one async authenticated read; strict drift and migration checks retain their fail-closed branches.
Added fetch-boundary tests for distinct rows, read_only request, second-statement refusal, sanitized 403, and malformed-row refusal; execution is reserved for root's guarded run.

findings.finding: Strict migrations returned success when public credentials were absent.
findings.disposition: ADDRESSED: operator fallback is attempted without public credentials; strict mode returns 2 if it also fails. A caller-level test asserts the previous false-green path now fails.

findings.finding: Private catalog predicates accepted shallow or malformed rows.
findings.disposition: ADDRESSED: shared validators require complete definition and surface field shapes, including an object parameter map and string-array inclusion lists. Focused tests cover valid and malformed rows.

findings.finding: Tests omitted missing authorization, malformed payloads, real caller predicates and strict exit paths.
findings.disposition: ADDRESSED IN SOURCE: helper tests now cover missing auth, malformed JSON and top-level payload; validator tests use the production predicates; migration caller test covers absent public credentials and strict refusal. Execution and RED/GREEN proof remain root-owned.

findings.finding: Migration script header still named the CLI.
findings.disposition: ADDRESSED: header now names the direct read-only Management API.

review_round_1.sibling_census: The same early public-credential return existed in docs:tools and tool-drift; both now attempt operator reads when the public configuration is absent.

live_catalog_correction.diagnosis: The Management API returned the canonical screenshot_region rect object parameter with required [x,y,w,h]. The shared validator rejected this valid nested JSON Schema required array because it accepted only boolean required fields.
live_catalog_correction.source_fix: DbToolRow and isDbToolRow now accept boolean or string[] required fields, rejecting mixed and object values. Both the drift comparator and generated-doc parameter summary mark a top-level parameter required only when required === true, so the nested array does not imply top-level rect presence.
live_catalog_correction.guard: tests/unit/tool-db-row-validation.test.ts includes the live rect contract as a valid fixture and rejects mixed-array and object required values. tests/unit/private-catalog-commands.test.ts checks the real docs command does not mislabel nested required members as top-level parameter presence and rejects malformed arrays.
live_catalog_correction.verification: Source-only; root must execute the focused guard and real strict release retest.

limitations: No tests, compile, build, SQL, or release were run by this worker under the active single-heavy-job lease.
The operator token is read only from process configuration or sibling aidream/.env; its value is never copied into extension env files or emitted in error messages.

Release-real-003 revealed a valid live nested required array that the validator rejected. Its source correction is complete; focused guard, real strict release retest, and any further peer verification remain root-owned.
